build_geometry_module: build a GeometryModule from vertex indices, UV coords, and UV indices to render index and barycentric images
create_uv_face_index: create a UV-space face index map that identifies which mesh face contains each texel using rasterize_meshes
compute_barycentric_coords: compute barycentric coordinates for 2D query points given the three vertices of their enclosing triangle
convert_depth_to_normals: convert a depth image to a normal image using camera focal lengths and principal points
project_3d_points: project a set of 3D points into multiple cameras using pinhole model extrinsics and intrinsics
